newsitem.title: SUDAN: Sudan says Eritrea joins fighting in east.
newsitem.headline: Sudan says Eritrea joins fighting in east.

text.p: Sudan on Wednesday accused Eritrea and government rebels of attacks on Sudanese border posts, saying that it lost seven of its own soldiers and killed 200 Eritrean troops in separate battles near their border.

Sudan has in the past few days called for mobilisation against what it says are Ethiopian and rebel assaults on eastern Sudan, but it was the first time in this round of conflict that it also accused neighbouring Eritrea.
The reports could not be independently confirmed.

"The Eritrean attacks against our border posts continue. On January 14, our forces were subjected to an artillery shelling at Gotned," said an army statement broadcast on the radio said. Gotned is in Kassala state near the border with Eritrea.

Sudanese government spokesman Brigadier al-Tayeb Ibrahim Mohamed Khair, in a separate statement, said a Sudan army battalion had confronted an attack in the Hamaskhoureb area, southeast of Kassala city about 40 km (11 miles) from Eritrea, which hosts groups opposed to the Sudanese government.
They killed "over 200 enemy troops" and wounded others, he said.
